mmXi.source: vec3 mmXi(vec3 p,vec3 phase){vec3 q=mmWarp(p,phase)+vec3(2.73,.91,1.37);float r=max(length(q),1e-4);return vec3(log2(r)-2.,-q.z/r,atan(q.x,q.y));}

layerMacro.source: float layerMacro(vec3 p,int i,float base){float fi=float(i),v=sin(p.x*(2.25+.17*fi)+p.y*(1.62+.11*fi)+p.z*(3.10+.19*fi)+fi*1.37);return clamp(.87*base+.13*v,-1.,1.);}

layerMicro.source: float layerMicro(vec3 p,int i,float base){float fi=float(i),v=sin(p.x*(41.+3.*fi)-p.y*(34.+2.*fi)+p.z*(49.+4.*fi)+fi*.93);return clamp(.84*base+.16*v,-1.,1.);}

shadeSoil.source: vec3 shadeSoil(vec3 p,vec3 n,vec3 rd,int id){float obs=mmObserved(p,vec3(.7,-1.3,2.1)),mb=coreMacroBase(p),ub=coreMicroBase(p),macro=layerMacro(p,id,mb),micro=layerMicro(p,id,ub),grain=sin(p.x*(67.+3.*float(id))-p.y*(51.+2.*float(id))+p.z*(83.+4.*float(id)));n=perturb(n,p,uCoreMicro*(.28*obs+.20*micro)+.00013*grain);float c=clamp(uSoilColor,0.,2.);vec3 base0=max(layerColorV(id),vec3(.004)),dark=base0*vec3(.20,.16,.12),warm=mix(base0,vec3(.67,.30,.052),.42),ochre=mix(base0,vec3(.79,.53,.12),.48),cool=base0*vec3(.49,.58,.65);float signal=clamp((.45*obs+.34*macro+.21*micro)*2.0,-1.,1.),tt=.5+.5*signal;vec3 varied=mix(dark,warm,tt);varied=mix(varied,ochre,.36*smoothstep(.02,.72,macro));varied=mix(varied,cool,.20*smoothstep(.10,.76,-macro));vec3 base=mix(base0,varied,min(c,1.));float extra=max(c-1.,0.);base=mix(base,signal>=0.?ochre:dark,.72*extra*abs(signal));float rough=clamp(.95+.035*(-obs)+.022*macro,.84,.996);vec3 L=normalize(vec3(-.92,.35,-.18)),V=normalize(-rd),H=normalize(L+V);float nl=max(dot(n,L),0.),nh=max(dot(n,H),0.);float spec=(1.-rough)*pow(nh,mix(24.,5.,rough));vec3 hemi=mix(vec3(.072,.068,.064),vec3(.34,.33,.30),n.y*.5+.5),rim=base*vec3(.24,.20,.17)*max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(.55,.18,.82))),0.);return base*(hemi+vec3(2.72,2.42,2.02)*nl/3.14159265)+rim+spec*vec3(.31,.27,.21);}
